E171 (Titanium dioxide): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E171: Titanium dioxide E171 is titanium dioxide, a white colour that makes sweets, icing and chewing gum bright and opaque. It has been banned as a food additive in the EU since…

E211 (Sodium benzoate): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E211: Sodium benzoate E211 is sodium benzoate, a preservative that stops yeasts and moulds growing in acidic foods like soft drinks, sauces and pickles.

E250 (Sodium nitrite): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E250: Sodium nitrite E250 is sodium nitrite, the preservative that cures ham and bacon. It stops dangerous bacteria, keeps the meat pink and gives it its cured taste.

E322 (Lecithin): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E322: Lecithins E322 is lecithin, a natural emulsifier usually taken from soy or sunflower. It helps chocolate flow, keeps spreads smooth and stops ingredients separating.

E330 (Citric acid): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E330: Citric acid E330 is citric acid, the same acid found in lemons. It adds a sour taste, controls acidity and helps foods keep their colour and freshness.

E415 (Xanthan gum): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E415: Xanthan gum E415 is xanthan gum, a thickener made by bacteria fermenting sugar. A pinch makes sauces thick and dressings stable, and it holds gluten-free bread together.

E471 (Mono- and diglycerides): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E471: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids E471 is an emulsifier made from fats and glycerol. It keeps bread soft for longer, makes ice cream smoother and stops spreads from separating.

E621 (MSG): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E621: Monosodium glutamate (MSG) E621 is monosodium glutamate (MSG), a flavour enhancer that adds a savoury, umami taste. It's the same glutamate found naturally in tomatoes, parmesan and…

E951 (Aspartame): What It Is, Uses and Safety | Supermarket Decoder E951: Aspartame E951 is aspartame, a low-calorie sweetener about 200 times sweeter than sugar. It's used in diet drinks, sugar-free gum and yoghurts.
